question: Which biennial NATO military exercise commenced on March 9, 2026, to strengthen deterrence and interoperability in the Arctic region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cold Response.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) launched its biennial Arctic military exercise, "Cold Response," on March 9, 2026, involving approximately 25,000 troops.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Participation:** The exercise features 14 NATO member nations, with major contributions from the **United States** (~4,000 personnel) and **Denmark**.
 
• **Arctic Sentry Mission:** Cold Response 2026 is now embedded within the **Arctic Sentry** framework, a standing high-readiness posture for the polar region.
 
• **Civil-Military Integration:** This iteration emphasizes integrating civilian capabilities into military operations in harsh Arctic conditions.
 
• **Strategic Context:** The drills serve as a deterrent and a de-escalation channel amid diplomatic tensions regarding **Greenland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization)__

 __
 
• An intergovernmental military alliance established by the North Atlantic Treaty (Washington Treaty) in 1949.
 
 
 
• High North__
 
 
• A term often used to describe the Arctic territories of the Nordic countries, focusing on the strategic and economic importance of the polar region.
